description: Captures the deterministic state evolution while the reference DOOM 1.9 plays back the DEMO1 lump from doom/DOOM1.WAD. DEMO1 is the first attract-loop demo (E1M5, recorded by Romero). State hashes per 02-012 and framebuffer hashes per 02-011 are captured at tic 0, every 35 tics, and at the demo end; the demo end tic equals (lumpsize - 13 header bytes) / 4 bytes-per-ticcmd. Entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: Launch DOOM.EXE in title-loop mode, allow the engine to auto-play DEMO1 after the title sequence; capture state + framebuffer at tic 0, every 35 tics, and at demo end. The vanilla demo header is 13 bytes (skill, episode, map, deathmatch, respawn, fast, nomonsters, consoleplayer, then four player-in-game flags) followed by 4-byte ticcmd records (forward, side, turn, buttons) terminated by 0x80.
